The '''Red Iaro''' was a revolutionary [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group on the planet [[Lannik/Legends|Lannik]] who sought to overthrow the [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]], which they viewed as evil and corrupt.

==History==
{{Quote|Most of the weapons were obsolete junk. The Lannik terrorists wouldn't even take them.|Aurra Sing, regarding arms being sold by the Hutts on Tatooine|<ref name="Star Wars (1998) 12">[[Star Wars (1998) 12|''Star Wars'' (1998) 12]]</ref>}}
[[File:MykchurFinuxZug-SW1998-14.jpg|thumb|150px|[[Myk'chur Finux Zug]], a member of the Red Iaro]]
When Lannik was troubled by the Red Iaro, [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] diplomats were sent to Lannik to help resolve the conflict. However, seven members of the organization were planning an attack, and ambushed the diplomats while they were on their way to meet the [[Lannik High Court]]. Luckily, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] was with them and managed to defeat them all, at the cost of his left eye. However, he chose not to undergo [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] treatment, and let the wound heal on its own. To him, the scar was a mark of honor and bravery. Because of this, the diplomat's daughter, [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]], was inspired to become a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. After it was found that she was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], she was taken into the Jedi order.

Several months after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], Piell encountered the Red Iaro again. Another round of peace talks was to begin, this time on the neutral planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. After the Iaro led an unsuccessful assassination attempt on the lives of the Jedi councilors, [[Myk'chur Finux Zug|their leader]], in an attempt to escape, was killed in a [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]] accident.
